title: Jensen Huang's biographer says Nvidia had a culture of omertà and deference toward Huang, who was quite arrogant, that enabled him to "be his worst self" (Stephen Witt/New York Times)
summary: Stephen Witt / New York Times: Jensen Huang's biographer says Nvidia had a culture of omertà and deference toward Huang, who was quite arrogant, that enabled him to “be his worst self” — We live in the age of artificial intelligence — an age that Jensen Huang, perhaps more than any other single person, has made possible.
contentText:
Stephen Witt / New York Times :

Jensen Huang's biographer says Nvidia had a culture of omertà and deference toward Huang, who was quite arrogant, that enabled him to “be his worst self”   —  We live in the age of artificial intelligence — an age that Jensen Huang, perhaps more than any other single person, has made possible.
